spec: Revision/SPEC.md sections 1, 5 and 7: the Kohn-Sham energy-momentum tensor as a source of the a4 and b4 equations, on the history a4 = H x4, b4 = b4(0) e^((4/3) H x4)
conditions: C1: every diagonal component of the source independent of x0 (for every a4 and b4)
C2: kappa (p3 + p_t - 2 p0) = sum_k alpha_k (E^x1_x1 + E^x5_x5 - 2 E^x0_x0); on the history with the author's weights: p3 + p_t = 2 p0
C3 (the history a4 = H x4, b4 = b4(0) e^((4/3) H x4), the author's weights, Lambda = -10): the constant source kappa (rho, p3, p_t, p0) = (-2/27, -2/9, -22/27, -14/27) at H = 1
C4 (off-diagonal): kappa q40 = cot z (b4'/b4) Q; on the history Q = 0, so q40 = q04 = 0
conclusion: No Kohn-Sham state recorded in Revision/kohn_sham is an admissible source of the author's metric: C1 fails for every nonzero state, for every a4(x4) and b4(x4); on the history C2 fails pointwise and after integration over x0, and the states are not the constant source C3 that the history needs (they have positive energy density changing with a4); the off-diagonal condition C4 holds.  The Kohn-Sham history a4 = H x4, b4 = b4(0) e^((4/3) H x4) is a prescribed background without back-reaction.

checks.name: ks_profiles_depend_on_x0
checks.detail: 75 ground-state profiles of Revision/kohn_sham/results/ground/profiles (70 with a nonzero energy-momentum tensor): for every nonzero one the energy density rho(y) varies along the hidden coordinate y (a function of x0 alone), (max rho - min rho)/max|T| >= 0.0757506 (smallest: N136_lamm2_a15); the diagonal left-hand sides of the a4 and b4 equations (a4-equations.json generalSource, x4, x1..x3, x5..x7 and x0 components) contain no x0 for every a4(x4) and b4(x4): True, so every component of an admissible diagonal source is independent of x0 (C1) and none of these states is an admissible source of the author's metric, for any history

checks.name: ks_profiles_violate_algebraic_condition
checks.detail: C2 for general b4: kappa (p3 + p_t - 2 p0) = sum_k alpha_k (E^x1_x1 + E^x5_x5 - 2 E^x0_x0) (a4-equations.json generalSource.identity_x1_plus_x5_minus_2x0); on the history a4 = H x4, b4 = b4(0) e^((4/3) H x4) with the author's weights the right-hand side is 0, so the condition is p3 + p_t = 2 p0; for every nonzero profile max_y |p3 + p_t - 2 p0| / max|T| lies between 1.04172 (N688_lamp2_a00) and 3.99008 (N8_lamm1_a20): it fails pointwise; example N136_lam0_a10 (N = 136, lambda = 0, a4,0 = 1; densities per Vol_7(a4,0)): y = -3: rho = 5.82892, p3 = 21.4192, p_t = -0, p0 = -58.4287, p3 + p_t - 2 p0 = 138.277 | y = -1.5: rho = 0.0957928, p3 = 0.06751, p_t = 0, p0 = 0.0870645, p3 + p_t - 2 p0 = -0.106619 | y = -0: rho = 0.000286337, p3 = 5.29482e-05, p_t = -0, p0 = 0.000127492, p3 + p_t - 2 p0 = -0.000202037

checks.name: ks_integrals_violate_algebraic_condition
checks.detail: integrated over the patch (results/ground/emt-integrals.csv: 2 Vol_7 int e^(6Hy) T dy), (int p3 + int p_t)/(2 int p0) differs from 1 for every nonzero state (closest to 1: 0.416888 at N688_lamm2_a00); for the history N = 136, lambda = 0: N136_lam0_a00: 0.339767, N136_lam0_a10: 0.25969, N136_lam0_a20: 0.239714 - even an x0-averaged (dimensionally reduced) source would violate p3 + p_t = 2 p0

checks.name: ks_history_is_a_prescribed_background
checks.detail: the Kohn-Sham history of Revision/kohn_sham (ks-theory.json adiabaticity.history: a4 = H x4, b4 = b4(0) e^((4/3) H x4), historyBeta = 4/3) needs, with the author's weights and Lambda = -10 (a4-equations.json exponentialHistory.requiredSource at AA = 1, be = 4/3), the constant source kappa (rho, p3, p_t, p0) = (-2/27, -2/9, -22/27, -14/27) (H = 1; for general H: 10 - 272*H**2/27, 88*H**2/9 - 10, 248*H**2/27 - 10, 256*H**2/27 - 10): a negative energy density, constant in x4 and x0, with p3/rho = 3, p_t/rho = 11, p0/rho = 7 (C3, reproduced: True). Along the history the Kohn-Sham source has (x0 averages per proper cell volume, in units of b4(0)^(-3/2)) N136_lam0_a00: rho_bar = 0.0151712, p3/rho = 0.296619, p_t/rho = 0, p0/rho = 0.436504; N136_lam0_a10: rho_bar = 0.000828218, p3/rho = 0.310021, p_t/rho = 0, p0/rho = 0.596905; N136_lam0_a20: rho_bar = 4.30746e-05, p3/rho = 0.326398, p_t/rho = 0, p0/rho = 0.680808; N688_lam0_a00: rho_bar = 0.128586, p3/rho = 0.292906, p_t/rho = 0, p0/rho = 0.353535; N688_lam0_a10: rho_bar = 0.00714624, p3/rho = 0.30183, p_t/rho = 0, p0/rho = 0.512507; N688_lam0_a20: rho_bar = 0.000382068, p3/rho = 0.318294, p_t/rho = 0, p0/rho = 0.648248: rho_bar > 0, it changes with a4,0 and its ratios are far from (3, 11, 7). The history is therefore a PRESCRIBED test-field background without back-reaction, not a solution of the a4 and b4 equations with the Kohn-Sham source; equations of state derived from it are not consequences of the coupled field equations

checks.name: ks_offdiagonal_condition_on_history
checks.detail: C4: kappa q40 = cot z (b4'/b4) Q (a4-equations.json generalSource.offDiagonal_x4x0); with the author's weights Q = 0 on the history (exponentialHistory.authorWeights.Q at AA = 1, be = 4/3: the reason why beta = 4/3), so q40 = q04 = 0 is required, and the Kohn-Sham states have it (ks-theory.json emt.offDiagonal: 'T^x4_y = 0 for eigen-orbitals (K_x4y = P (eps - v/2) c_o, c_'): the off-diagonal condition holds on the history; it is the diagonal conditions C1 to C3 that exclude the states. In Einstein gravity ((3*cc*H*uu)/2 == kappa*q40) a source with q40 = 0 forces b4' = 0, which the history excludes

checks.name: ks_zero_source_states_listed
checks.detail: 5 states have an identically vanishing energy-momentum tensor (zero source): N8_lam0_a00, N8_lam0_a05, N8_lam0_a10, N8_lam0_a15, N8_lam0_a20. A zero source is not admissible on the history either: with the author's weights every vacuum solution has b4 constant (a4-equations.json key b4.background; b4 is never constant here), and in Einstein gravity the equations have no vacuum solution for H > 0 (einstein.noVacuum)
